name: Reinforced Hot Spring Statue
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon

defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 10)
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, a giant animated statue has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once a giant animated statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 22.

offensiveAbilities.name: Boil Alive
offensiveAbilities.description: The statue hinges open, revealing boiling water within it, and then plunges a creature it has Grabbed or Restrained in. The target takes 3d10 Fire Damage] damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Geothermally Heated
offensiveAbilities.description: The statue is magically powered by the same geothermal power that heats the waters in Maecho's hot springs. Dealing 18 cold damage to the statue cools it off, preventing it from using Boil Alive, removing the fire damage from its ranged attacks, and making it Slowed 1 for one round, after which the cold water cycles out of the statue and it returns to its usual temperature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
